mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a tightening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high industrial production (INDPRO above 115) indicates overcapacity and impending slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 115, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate above 2.5%) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment and decrease in unemployment rate (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten policy, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.
